subject: Is it possble to have multiple server types for an entity

messages.author: c1f1808bc5ccecef
messages.subject: Is it possble to have multiple server types for an entity
parts:
Hi - I am modelling a medical situation where some patient types can be served by either of two staff types, but other patient types can only be served by one of the types (think, for example of the situation where a minor complaint can be served by a junior or senior doctor, but a serious complaint can only be served by a senior doctor). Is there a way to implement this in simmer?

Thanks, Cameron

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] Is it possble to have multiple server types for an entity
parts:
It depends on the arrival process. If you can split it up in two, one for each patient type, you can set up two generators feeding two different trajectories. If all arrivals must come from the same generator, you can tag them with an attribute. 

To decide which resource they should visit, you can use a branch or the new feature select/seize_selected.
